Force Burst Lv. 1 Supplements the user's P. Atk. with 129 Power in a powerful burst of energy. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Force Storm Lv. 1 Supplements the user's P. Atk. with 181 Power in a powerful indirect energy blast. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Focused Force Lv. 1 Channels force energy when using a hand-to-hand and blunt weapon. Can be charged up to Level 1.
Force Blaster Lv. 1 Discharges a powerful energy beam at an enemy with 143 Power added to P. Atk. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Punch of Doom Lv. 1 Inflicts great damage with 4580 Power on the opponent with iron-fist. Ignores Shield Defence. Over-hit. Critical
Burning Fist Lv. 1 Hurls a Fire type iron-fist to attack the target with 517 Power added to P. Atk. Ignores Shield Defence. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Hurricane Assault Lv. 1 Supplements the user's P. Atk. with 501 Power to strike the target with rapid consecutive strikes. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible. Ignores Shield Defence.
Raging Force Lv. 1 Attacks the enemy. Energy Charges can be gathered up to stage 4. Over-hit and Critical hit are possible.
Break Duress Lv. 1 Use your spirit to escape from an immobile state.
Maximum Focus Force Lv. 1 Immediately grants maximum Energy Charges.
Bear Spirit Totem Lv. 1 With Dual Fist, Sword, Blunt/Dual Blunt: P. Atk. +20% P. Crit. Damage +20%. Speed -30%.
Wolf Spirit Totem Lv. 1 Speed +20% With Dual Fist, Sword, Blunt/Dual Blunt: Accuracy +3.
Ogre Spirit Totem Lv. 1 P. Def. +30% M. Def. +30%. With Dual Fist: P. Atk. +30% P. Crit. Damage +10%.
Puma Spirit Totem Lv. 1 With Dual Fist, Sword, Blunt/Dual Blunt: Atk. Spd. +20% Accuracy +6.
Bison Spirit Totem Lv. 1 With Dual Fist, Sword, Blunt/Dual Blunt: Accuracy +6. When HP < 60%: P. Atk. +10% P. Crit. Rate +100. When HP < 30%: P. Atk. +30% P. Crit. Rate +300.
Rabbit Spirit Totem Lv. 1 With Dual Fist: Atk. Spd. +30%. With Light Armor: Speed +25% Evasion +12.

Zealot Lv. 1 Speed +10 P. Skills MP Consumption -50% Resistance to debuffs +80% Resistance to buff-canceling attacks +40% Incoming Heal Power -50%. With Sword, Blunt, Fists, Polearm: Accuracy +6 Atk. Spd. +10%. With Sword, Polearm: P. Crit. Rate +33. With Blunt, Fists: P. Crit. Damage +33%.
Dark Form Lv. 1 Fire Atk. Attribute. Resistance to Fire +3%.
Hawk Spirit Totem Lv. 1 With Dual Fist, Sword, Blunt/Dual Blunt: Accuracy +6. With Dual Fist, Blunt/Dual Blunt: P. Crit. Rate +100 P. Crit. Damage +30%.
Force Meditation Lv. 1 Restores 60 HP and 10 MP every second. Applies to user: P. Def. -80%. User is unable to move. Effect is canceled if user is attacked.
Force Barrier Lv. 1 Makes user invincible against damage and debuffs. Effect is canceled if any action other than movement is initiated.
Final Secret Lv. 1 Attack Damage in PvP +15% P. Skills Power in PvP and PvE +30%.
Cripple Lv. 1 Decreases an enemy's Speed by 20%.
Soul Breaker Lv. 1 Hurls an iron-fist to attack the target with 487 Power added to P. Atk. and inflicts Stun. Ignores Shield Defence. Over-hit. Critical.
Pain for Gain Lv. 1 Reduces HP by 70% and limits HP recovery to no more than 20% of the maximum. Decreases Resistance to Debuff by 30%.
Common Craft Lv. 1 Can read common recipe books.
Fury Fists Lv. 1 Atk. Spd. +25%. Consumes 12 HP per second.
Relax Lv. 1 Increases HP Recovery Bonus by 5. While sitting, 1 MP is consumed per second.
Fortitude Lv. 1 Resistance to Paralyze +30% Resistance to Stun +30%. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.

Riposte Stance Lv. 1 Returns 20% of received standard short-range damage back to an enemy Reflects debuffs with 20% probability Speed -5% Atk. Spd. -10% Accuracy -3. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.
War Frenzy Lv. 1 Resistance to Stun +5% Resistance to Sleep +10%. Continuously consumes MP proportionately to the user's level.
Block Buff Lv. 1 Switchable skill. Your character cannot receive external buff effects.
Asceticism Lv. 1 While this skill is active, Vampiric-type effects do not restore your health.
Charge Lv. 1 Charges toward an enemy. Consumes 5% of current HP on use. Can't be used with a Bow. Minimal range: 200.
Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 8.5% and additionally by 2.
Armor Mastery Lv. 1 P. Def. +9 and MP Recovery Bonus by 10%.
Fist Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 4.5 when using a hand-to-hand weapon.
Light Armor Mastery Lv. 1 With Light Armor: P. Def. +1 Evasion +4 Received P. Crit. Rate -15%.
Expertise D Lv. 1 Increases expertise in using D-grade equipment.
Sword/Blunt Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 4.5 when using one-handed/two-handed Sword or one-handed/two-handed/dual Blunt weapon.
Two-handed Weapon Mastery Lv. 1 Increases P. Atk. by 4.5 and Accuracy by 3 when using a two-handed sword or a two-handed blunt weapon.
Agile Movement Lv. 1 Accuracy +2 and Speed by 5 when equipped with light armor.
Create Common Item Lv. 1 Creates level 1 common items.
Toughness Lv. 1 Resistance to Sleep/Hold/Poison +20%.
Boost Attack Speed Lv. 1 Atk. Spd. +5%.
Lucky Lv. 1 At lv 10 or lower, the user will not experience loss of Exp, and after-death effect upon death.
Wisdom Lv. 1 Resistance to Hold +10% Resistance to Sleep +10% Resistance to Mental attacks +10%.
Health Lv. 1 Resistance to Poison +10% Resistance to Bleeding +10%.
Armor Destruction Lv. 1 Ordinary attacks have a 50% chance to apply to enemy: Resistance to Dual Fist attacks -3%. Duration: 10 sec.
Iron Body Lv. 1 Environment-related damage is decreased by 40%.
Fighter's Will Lv. 1 With any weapon: P. Skills Power +5% P. Crit. Rate +5%. With short-range weapon: P. Atk. +5% Atk. Spd. +5%.
Archer's Will Lv. 1 With any weapon: Speed +2 Accuracy +3. Only with Bow: P. Atk. +5% Skills Range +5% Attack Range +50.
Expose Weak Point Lv. 1 When attacked, 5% chance apply to enemy: P. Def. -20% Received P. Crit. Rate +30%. Duration: 15 sec. Reuse time: 30 sec.
Magician's Will Lv. 1 M. Atk. +5% Cast. Spd. +5% M. Crit. Rate +5% All skills MP Consumption -5%.

Force Mastery Lv. 1 Absorbs the target's energy. Energy can be absorbed with a 15% chance for regular physical attacks and 30% during a critical attack. Applies when a hand-to-hand combat weapon is equipped. Up to 1 stage of energy can be absorbed.
Divine Inspiration Lv. 1 Increases the number of buffs an individual can receive by 1 (+1: 20 => 21).
Knock Lv. 1 When using 'Rush', 'Assault', 'Charge', 'Blazing Boost', applies to enemy: Speed -50%.
Skill Mastery Lv. 1 Depending on user's STR, the re-use time resets or the duration doubles.
Master of Combat Lv. 1 Max CP +3% P. Atk. with Sword/Dual Sword, Blunt/Dual Blunt, Polearm, Dual Fist +25.
